device.description: 16-bit 15-240 SPS delta-sigma ADC with 2-channel differential / 3-channel single-ended MUX, PGA, 2.048 V reference and I2C interface
device.note: ads1112.pdf (SBAS282D) p.2 pinout and terminal functions, p.3 electrical characteristics (VDD 2.7-5.5 V, VIH max 6 V, data rates), p.7 output codes, p.8 operating modes and reset, p.9-10 I2C address (Table 4) and general call, p.10-11 output and configuration registers (default 8Ch), p.12 read/write

commands.name: Write Configuration
commands.note: one byte after the address byte; further bytes are ignored and not acknowledged

pages: p.2 (pinout), p.3 (EC), p.7 (codes), p.8 (modes), p.9-10 (I2C address, general call), p.10-12 (registers, read/write)
notModeled: analog input, MUX and PGA (INP/PGA stored only)
floating address pins (Table 4: A0 or A1 floating gives 1001001b, 1001011b, 1001101b, 1001111b; both floating invalid)
address pins are latched only at power-up or on a general call (04h latch, 06h latch and reset); the model reads them continuously
ST/DRDY is set back to 1 when the configuration byte is read; the model sets it when the output register is read (onRead)
lower resolution at faster data rates (12/14/15 bits, sign-extended): the 0 V code is 0 at every rate
conversion times are 1 / the EC minimum data rate (180, 45, 22, 11 SPS), the worst case
writing 1 to ST/DRDY during a conversion restarts it in the model (the datasheet: no effect)
I2C high-speed mode entry code and timing limits
